ctx.x: Excuse me. They have inserted here -- the writer has inserted trombone in parentheses with a question mark, but it has B. Morton, Guy Jackson and Cleo Good, Alfred Gibson as saxophone players.
Alfred Gibson is correct. He's out of Cleveland, Ohio.
